title: Radiation in Space
body: 600 mSv career limit (NASA 2022). 50 mSv/yr watch line. Shielding + time + distance reduces dose.

title: Hypoxia
body: SpO2 <95% watch, <90% crit. Check O2 loop, exertion, cabin pressure.

title: Hypertension WHO/ISH
body: 130/85 high-normal, 140/90 grade1, 180/110 grade3 crisis. Recheck after 5 min rest.

title: Fatigue & Stress
body: Simulated stress 55 watch, 80 crit. Sleep + hydration + task rotation counters fatigue.
